card.title: One Step from Distance
card.instruction: Treat pauses, divided attention, and small boundaries as signs that the connection may be slipping away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You took longer to answer my message today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A meeting I used to hear about.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me one boring detail so I know there's still room.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats delayed response as significant, A3 reads the unshared meeting as exclusion, and A5 seeks a trivial detail as proof of remaining space.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's meeting explanation becomes A3's past-sharing comparison; B4's just-work dismissal makes A5 ask for a boring detail rather than importance.

relationship.evidence: B2 provides a normal reason for delay and B4 distinguishes routine work from a meaningful omission.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's ordinary-work description to request precisely an ordinary detail; the scale stays intentionally small.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's boring-detail request reveals the connection concern without requiring an elaborate accusation.
